scope: Exhaustive verified declaration-bearing explicit exports and wildcard matches of every package-version in the pinned inventory; runtime aliases, legacy channels, declaration-only file paths and non-declaration exports remain explicit. This is a target/ownership plan, not a claim of generated or tested SDK coverage.

layout.Core: Shared language/runtime declaration ownership and common support.
layout.Runtime: Workers-native declarations, executable SDKs, browser/framework clients, AI/Agents, compute and Pages adapters.
layout.Management: Official OpenAPI through Hawaii; unscoped cloudflare TypeScript package retained only as audited SDK provenance.
layout.Tenancy: Tenant-specific composition over generated management contracts; no independent npm SDK invented.
layout.moduleRule: Flat F# module leaves below FSharp.CloudEdge.Runtime, with logical category directories, avoid module-prefix collisions.

inventoryFindings.text: Workers AI provider 4 and AI Gateway provider 4 target AI SDK 7; current AI Search provider 0.1.1 targets AI SDK 6. AI Search documentation uses Workers AI provider 3 for that combined profile.
Computer and Sandbox dependencies on capnweb ^0.8 do not accept latest capnweb 0.12; retain dependency-specific versions instead of forcing one latest version.
Browser MCP docs describe 1.1.1, but registry latest is 0.0.5 with older Agents and Playwright dependency ranges.
Some RealtimeKit quickstart names are absent from registry; SDK selection names actual core and UI packages.
Agents 0.22.0 has 37 manifest export entries, of which 36 have explicit declaration targets; tsconfig is not an SDK type entrypoint. Root-only generation misses separately exported surfaces.

Current Sessions guide imports agents/experimental/memory/utils/compaction-helpers, whereas the manifest exports the utils barrel. Verify public import resolution rather than treating documentation imports as package exports.

Codemode Vite integration supplies the CodemodeRuntime Worker export. Generated Fable consumers must retain required runtime classes/exports and binding configuration; declarations alone do not implement SDK behavior.
Computer is a published preview; source-only private sibling packages must not be counted as independent installable SDKs.

audit.verification: Every downloaded tarball matched the inventory SRI; package name/version and selected declaration paths checked from its archive, with no installs or lifecycle execution.
audit.conditionalSelection: Prefer modern ESM/default declarations for the suggested entry; preserve require, Bun, workerd and legacy TypeScript alternatives without claiming full npm conditional resolution.
audit.managementCoverage: API schema is authoritative for Hawaii; TypeScript resource leaf count is not a requirement for separate Xantham projects.
audit.reExportEvidenceLimit: Edges are parsed from declaration export structure. Star/named re-exports and same-file sharing are suggestions for a shared owner; complete exported-name coverage must still be checked after generation. Import graph reachability is explicitly weaker evidence.
audit.registryManifestOrder: Published tarball manifests supply original export-condition order and file existence. Suggested entries deliberately choose modern ESM/default declarations; the plan is not a general npm condition resolver.
audit.externalImportInventoryLimit: declarationExternalImports is a conservative textual discovery set. Import-looking documentation examples are not authoritative dependencies; a syntax-aware installed-profile audit must confirm optional peers before installation.
